title: Play and finish a level 1 solo round
description: This verifies that a single player can choose level 1, make guesses, receive trajectory feedback, and complete the round with attempts updating correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the Single Player mode entry
Choose Level 1
Enter a valid guess into the guess field
Submit the guess
Verify archery feedback is displayed and the remaining attempts update

title: Complete a tournament with custom players and view the podium
description: This verifies that a tournament can be configured with custom names, played through local handovers, and ավարտed with a final leaderboard and winners podium.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the Tournament mode entry
Choose the number of players
Enter custom names for all players
Start the tournament
Mark the current player as ready
Enter a valid guess for the current player
Submit the guess
Continue through the remaining turns until the tournament ends
Verify the final leaderboard and winners podium are displayed

title: Start single player mode from the main menu
description: This verifies that a player can choose the solo mode from the main screen and begin the single player setup flow.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the Single Player mode entry
Verify the single player setup screen is displayed

title: Win a duel and reveal both secrets
description: This test verifies that a duel can be resolved by a correct guess and that the result screen reveals both secret numbers and the winner.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the Head-to-Head Duel mode entry
Fill in a valid secret number for the first player
Fill in a valid secret number for the second player
Start the duel
Submit a guess that matches the current opponent secret number
Verify the duel result screen is displayed
Verify both secret numbers and the winner are revealed

title: Resolve a duel on the first correct guess and reveal the winner
description: This verifies that alternating guesses in duel mode can end the match immediately when one player finds the opponent's secret number and the winner plus both secrets are revealed.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the Head-to-Head Duel mode entry
Enter a secret number for player one
Enter a secret number for player two
Start the duel
Enter a valid guess for the current player
Submit the guess
Continue alternating guesses until one player wins
Verify the winner and both secret numbers are revealed

title: Start tournament mode from the main menu
description: This verifies that a player can choose the tournament mode from the main screen and begin the tournament setup flow.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the Tournament mode entry
Verify the tournament setup screen is displayed

title: Start a duel match and reach alternating turns
description: This test verifies that a player can configure both secret numbers, start a duel, and reach the alternating guessing phase with the correct match state ready.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the Head-to-Head Duel mode entry
Fill in a valid secret number for the first player
Fill in a valid secret number for the second player
Start the duel
Verify the duel turn-taking interface is displayed
Verify the current turn indicator is shown

title: Start duel mode from the main menu
description: This verifies that a player can choose the head-to-head duel mode from the main screen and begin the duel setup flow.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the Head-to-Head Duel mode entry
Verify the duel setup screen is displayed

title: Persist audio setting across sessions
description: This verifies that the audio toggle state is restored after leaving the app and returning later.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Toggle the audio setting off
Leave the app and return to the main screen
Verify the audio setting remains off

title: Mute and unmute audio from the header
description: This test verifies that audio can be toggled from the header and the setting changes the current sound state.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Toggle the audio setting off
Toggle the audio setting on
Verify the audio setting reflects the muted and unmuted state changes
Verify the header audio control remains available

title: Alternate turns correctly in tournament play
description: This verifies that after one player's guess, the next player is handed the device and the turn sequence continues correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the Tournament mode entry
Choose the number of players
Enter custom names for all players
Start the tournament
Mark the current player as ready
Enter a valid guess for the current player
Submit the guess
Verify the next player handover screen is displayed

title: Show the private handover before each tournament turn
description: This verifies that tournament play uses a private handover screen before each player begins their turn.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the Tournament mode entry
Choose the number of players
Enter custom names for all players
Start the tournament
Verify the private handover screen is displayed before play begins

title: Set both duel secrets and begin the match
description: This verifies that both players can enter secret numbers and start a head-to-head duel with the proper setup completed.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the Head-to-Head Duel mode entry
Enter a secret number for player one
Enter a secret number for player two
Start the duel
Verify the duel match screen is displayed

title: Alternate duel guesses between players
description: This test verifies that duel turns alternate correctly when guesses are incorrect and that the game hands control to the other player after each turn.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the Head-to-Head Duel mode entry
Fill in a valid secret number for the first player
Fill in a valid secret number for the second player
Start the duel
Submit an incorrect guess
Submit another incorrect guess on the next turn
Verify the turn alternates between the two players
Verify guess feedback is shown after each turn

title: Restart a solo game after completion
description: This verifies that a completed single player session can be restarted into a fresh new game.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the Single Player mode entry
Choose Level 1
Complete the round
Click Restart
Verify a new single player session is displayed

title: Restore audio preference after returning to the app
description: This test verifies that the chosen audio setting is remembered locally after leaving and returning to the app.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Toggle the audio setting off
Leave the page
Navigate back to /
Verify the audio setting remains muted after returning
Verify the main interface loads normally after returning

title: Use keyboard submission in solo play
description: This verifies that a single player can submit a guess with the keyboard and continue the round normally.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the Single Player mode entry
Choose Level 1
Enter a valid guess into the guess field
Press Enter
Verify the guess is submitted and gameplay feedback is displayed

title: Switch between all play modes from the home screen
description: This test verifies that selecting each main mode from the home screen opens the correct setup flow without leaking state from another mode.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the Single Player mode setup
Return to the home screen
Open the Tournament mode setup
Return to the home screen
Open the Head-to-Head Duel mode setup
Verify each mode opens its own setup flow
Verify no previous mode state is carried into the final setup screen

title: Trigger the level 2 extreme hint
description: This verifies that level 2 shows the extreme hint when a guess is far from the target.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the Single Player mode entry
Choose Level 2
Enter a distant valid guess into the guess field
Submit the guess
Verify the extreme hint is displayed

title: Reject invalid tournament player setup
description: This verifies that tournament setup prevents starting with an invalid player count or incomplete player names.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the Tournament mode entry
Attempt to start the tournament with an invalid player count or incomplete names
Verify setup validation is displayed and the tournament does not start

title: Reject invalid duel secret numbers
description: This test verifies that the duel setup prevents starting with invalid secret number input and shows validation feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the Head-to-Head Duel mode entry
Leave the first secret number empty
Enter an invalid secret number for the second player
Attempt to start the duel
Verify validation errors are shown for the invalid secret number inputs
Verify the duel does not start
